source_locator: 113年版盤查作業指引, section 2-8, unit conversion factor
allowed_use: Convert a known energy quantity expressed in kcal to TJ.
prohibited_use: Do not use this conversion by itself to convert litres or cubic metres of fuel to TJ. A verified fuel-specific lower heating value is still required.
notes: Physical energy-unit conversion only. This does not provide a diesel kcal/L value or a natural-gas kcal/m3 value.
